title: The Bible in One Year
description: Read through the entire Bible in 365 days. Approximately 3-4 chapters each day, from Genesis to Revelation.

title: The Bible in Two Years
description: A gentler pace through all of Scripture. 1-2 chapters per day, perfect for deeper reflection.

title: New Testament in 90 Days
description: Journey through the Gospels, Acts, the Epistles, and Revelation in three months.

title: Psalms in 30 Days
description: Immerse yourself in the Psalms, the prayerbook of the Bible. Five psalms each day.

title: The Four Gospels in 40 Days
description: Walk with Jesus through Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John over forty days of reading.

title: Proverbs in 31 Days
description: One chapter of wisdom each day. Perfect for a month of daily reflection on godly living.

title: Paul's Letters in 21 Days
description: Read all thirteen of Paul's epistles in three weeks. Theology, encouragement, and practical wisdom.
